## Core Technical Competencies & Services

### 1. Automated ETL / ELT Pipeline Architecture
- Ingesting, cleaning, and transforming high-volume data from 3rd-party APIs, transactional SQL databases, and flat files.
- Orchestrating automated pipelines using Python and dbt Core.
- Designing dimensional models and staging layers in cloud data warehouses (AWS Redshift, PostgreSQL, SQL Server).

### 2. SQL Performance Tuning & Query Optimization
- Profiling execution plans, eliminating expensive table scans, implementing indexing strategies, and refactoring subqueries.
- Proven track record of reducing query execution times from minutes down to seconds for high-concurrency dashboards.

### 3. Executive Business Intelligence & Reporting
- Building automated, interactive executive dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, and SSRS.
- Developing advanced DAX measures, dimensional modeling, and financial reporting automation.

### 4. Data Automation, Security & Systems Administration
- Enterprise AES-256 column-level encryption for PDPA / data privacy compliance.
- Automated EDI and secure financial file delivery via SFTP and SSIS (integrated with CozyRoc connectors).
- Self-hosted Debian 12 staging servers with containerized Docker services and ZeroTier encrypted software-defined mesh network.
